tips.title: Demo account [management tips.]
tips.description: Most traders use demo accounts wrong — they treat them as games. Here is how serious traders extract real intelligence.

items.title: Mirror your real capital, not your fantasy capital
items.text: Set virtual funds to match the deposit you would actually trade live. Risk behaviour at $5,000 is fundamentally different from $500,000.

items.title: Keep a structured trade journal
items.text: Log every entry rationale, exit reasoning, and emotional state. A demo without a journal is just noise — with one, it's calibration data.

items.title: Track edge metrics, not just P/L
items.text: Win rate, average R-multiple, max drawdown, and consistency curve matter more than absolute returns over short windows.

items.title: Know when to graduate to live
items.text: When your edge is stable across 60+ trades and you can replicate execution with discipline — it's time to scale into real capital.

note.title: Demo Isn't Training Wheels. It's A Wind Tunnel.

meta.description: GTC Global Ltd and GTC Global Trade Capital Ltd are members of the Financial Commission — independent dispute resolution and up to €20,000 compensation per client.

hero.title: Financial Commission Dispute Resolution and [Compensation Fund]
hero.text: Both GTC Global Ltd and GTC Global Trade Capital Ltd jointed Financial Commission as official members — Financial Commission, an international organization dedicated to resolving financial service disputes in the foreign exchange industry and providing traders with additional financial protection.

about.whatText: As a neutral third-party commission, the Financial Commission impartially reviews and resolves transaction disputes, offering a simpler and faster solution compared to industry regulators and judicial proceedings. Independent of any party, the commission ensures that dispute resolution is swift, efficient, fair, and credible.
about.bringTitle: What does it bring to traders?
bring: Fast, fair, and transparent dispute resolution
Additional funding is provided by the Compensation Fund.
A fully independent third-party external dispute resolution (EDR) institution.

managed.title: How are the [funds managed?]
managed.description: The Compensation Fund is a compensation mechanism maintained by the Financial Commission for eligible clients of its members. According to the Financial Commission's Rules, the Fund is held in a separate bank account and may be used to satisfy an eligible Award if a member fails or refuses to comply with that Award, or ceases to be a member before paying it. Any payment is subject to the applicable Rules, compensation limits and available fund balance. The Fund is not an insurance policy, deposit-guarantee scheme or general protection against trading losses or broker insolvency. It applies only to eligible claims made against the specific legal entity that holds Financial Commission membership.

steps.title: Member monthly fee
steps.text: Monthly membership dues are collected from participating broker members.

steps.title: Special allocation
steps.text: 10% of monthly membership dues are allocated to the Compensation Fund.

steps.title: Independent account storage
steps.text: Funds are held in a separate bank account, independent from member operations.

steps.title: By the Financial Commission
steps.text: Used only when a member refuses to adhere to a Financial Commission judgment.

funding.text: The Compensation Fund is continuously funded by the Financial Commission at 10% of its monthly membership fees to ensure its stable operation.

coverage.text: Each client is guaranteed up to €20,000 in compensation in the event of a Financial Commission ruling.

scope.title: Under what circumstances is [protection guaranteed?]
scope.description: The fund applies only to formal rulings made by the Financial Commission, and the clearly defined coverage ensures that the safeguard mechanism is transparent and predictable.
covered: The official ruling issued by the Financial Commission
Financial compensation when a member refuses to comply with a ruling
The maximum compensation amount is €20,000 per client.
excluded: Losses arising from traders' independent trading
Financial problems for all clients due to brokerage firm bankruptcy
Disputes not adjudicated by the Financial Commission
